title: Asked to work on electron flow for back-engineering

tellings.quote: I know they were working on it a long time ago because I was asked to to work on which way electrons move.

plain: People were trying to reverse engineer alien technology, meaning take it apart to learn how it works, long ago, says a man named Chris Bledsoe, whom NASA has studied because UFOs seem to appear around him. He tells Michels he knows this because he was once asked to work on which way electrons move, a question he says was part of that effort.
